Tag pairing and raw attribute provenance pass targeted checks, but the oracle can erase all tags on an unlisted source.
Setext and the exact HTML/ATX heading witnesses pass, but l fabricates an ATX heading and the oracle does not derive headings generally.
Declared invalid biblio and slash negatives pass, while valid default manual links, empty-slash definitions, visible-text targets, and section references remain incomplete.
Attribute entity decoding and href resolution pass; semantic definition text still retains entity source spelling and misses a valid carrier join.
The exact closed-container owner witness passes, but admitted-operation owner and ledger-evidence substitution is not rejected.
Only REVIEWED_ACCEPTED is admitted and union collisions are reported, but the semantic ledger authority remains absent and the verifier does not compare all admitted operation fields.
The six frozen hostile option cases pass; a revoked ledger-array proxy still escapes as TypeError.
The declarative table is independent in bytes but not general in semantics: its rules are inert and exact-source witnesses do not cover variations.
Separate work observations and honest no-bound labels pass, but aggregate work suppression is accepted.

Implement the documented autolink inside grammar, including empty slash, type and visible-text segments, local/cross-spec section references, and exact target extraction rather than treating the whole body as the target.
Separate autolink eligibility from structural source state so l can enable only autolink recognition without enabling Markdown headings, and make l override disabled shorthand categories as declared.
Decode semantic HTML text content for definition and heading carrier names while retaining raw byte provenance.
Protect Array.isArray and every later ledger validation operation from hostile proxies and values, and freeze each escape as an exact negative control.

Replace exact-source-only semantic authority with independently executable general rules or a sufficiently broad external semantic oracle; add mutations on non-witness source variations for states, tags, headings, references, carriers, URLs, containers, and operations.
Compare every admitted operation's kind, anchor, source-derived owner, heading fields, and copied ledger evidence against both its operation candidate and exact reviewed ledger row.
Recompute and verify total_instrumented_units, while retaining the honest non-formal, zero-benchmark resource classification.

Keep all denominator, semantic, operation, owner, compatibility, parser, feature, benchmark, and production credit at zero and do not run the 168-source corpus until two fresh exact-byte reviews and root adjudication accept a repaired subject.
